tasks.title: Add resolveConflicts callback parameter to createIssueRoutes and wire into rebase handler
tasks.description: Add an optional `resolveConflicts` callback parameter to `createIssueRoutes` signature. In the rebase handler (POST /:number/rebase), change `abortOnConflict` from true to false. When conflicts are detected and `resolveConflicts` is provided, emit `rebase_conflict` with status:'resolving', call the callback, then on success call `worktreeManager.rebaseContinue()`. On failure, call `worktreeManager.abortRebase()`, emit `rebase_conflict` with status:'failed', return 409. If `resolveConflicts` is not provided, keep current abort+409 behavior. After successful rebaseContinue, proceed with existing stage post-processing (handleReviewRebase/handlePlanRebase/handleBuildRebase).
acceptanceCriteria: createIssueRoutes accepts optional resolveConflicts callback: `(issue: Issue, worktreePath: string, conflictFiles: string[]) => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>`
rebase handler uses abortOnConflict: false
Conflict detected + resolveConflicts provided: emit rebase_conflict status:'resolving', call resolveConflicts, on success rebaseContinue then stage post-processing, return 200 with autoResolved:true
Conflict detected + resolveConflicts provided + agent fails: abortRebase, emit rebase_conflict status:'failed', return 409
Conflict detected + no resolveConflicts: abortRebase, emit rebase_conflict, return 409 (current behavior preserved)
Successful rebase response includes autoResolved:true when agent resolved conflicts

tasks.title: Update IssueDetailPage UI for rebase conflict resolution progress
tasks.description: Update IssueDetailPage.tsx to track rebase conflict resolution state via SSE events. Add state for `rebaseResolving` that tracks whether the rebase is in auto-resolution mode. When `rebase_conflict` event with status:'resolving' is received, show 'Resolving conflicts...' spinner with conflict file list and disable rebase button. When `rebase_completed` is received after resolving, show success with 'Auto-resolved' label. When `rebase_conflict` with status:'failed' is received, show error with file list and re-enable rebase button.
